Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Doon University Young Professional I Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for Doon University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 26 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they report to the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional-I (YP-I) post?
faq.answer: A Master’s Degree (M.Sc.) in Environmental Science, Agricultural Science, or a closely related discipline from a recognized University is required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Young Professional-I (YP-I) position?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 21 years and the maximum age is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional-I (YP-I) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 30,000 Per Month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC, SC/ST categories for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Young Professional-I (YP-I) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Young Professional-I (YP-I) post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the Doon University located?
faq.answer: Doon University is located in Dehradun, Uttarakhand, with the pincode 248001.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, and category certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job for the Young Professional-I (YP-I) post at Doon University.
